answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 54 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the violet challenge, the plume audit can replay the delta history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2169 identities would post 1200 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
